name: COLONIZED

description.en: COLONIZED is a space survival MMORPG for PC, built in Unreal Engine 5: one persistent online universe, planets with atmosphere and ships you can walk through.
description.es: COLONIZED es un MMORPG de supervivencia espacial para PC, hecho con Unreal Engine 5: un universo online persistente, planetas con atmósfera y naves que se recorren por dentro.

status.en: In development. Applications for the closed alpha are open at colonized.work; the first alpha wave is planned for winter 2026-2027.
status.es: En desarrollo. Las solicitudes para la alfa cerrada están abiertas en colonized.work; la primera oleada de la alfa está prevista para el invierno 2026-2027.

setting.en: Year 47 E.A. In the Aurin system of the Parhelion galaxy, two factions born from the same colony fleet, the Zenith and the Nadir, keep a cold peace that is starting to crack.
setting.es: Año 47 E.A. En el sistema Aurin de la galaxia Parhelion, dos facciones nacidas de la misma flota colonizadora, los Cenit y los Nadir, sostienen una paz fría que empieza a agrietarse.

creator.name: Vanguille
creator.nameNote: Public pseudonym of the creator; the real name is not published outside the legal notice.
creator.role: Sole creator and director of COLONIZED

oneLine.en: COLONIZED is the space-survival MMO that Vanguille has been building solo for over ten years.
oneLine.es: COLONIZED es el MMO de supervivencia espacial que construye Vanguille, en solitario, desde hace más de diez años.

answer.en: Vanguille is the sole creator of COLONIZED, the space survival MMORPG for PC built in Unreal Engine 5. He has worked on the project for more than ten years and has built the game, its servers, this website and its community on his own, with AI only as a tool.
answer.es: Vanguille es el creador único de COLONIZED, el MMORPG de supervivencia espacial para PC hecho con Unreal Engine 5. Lleva más de diez años con el proyecto y ha levantado él solo el juego, sus servidores, esta web y su comunidad, con la IA solo como herramienta.

creator.withTheProject: More than ten years (declared by the creator)
creator.experience: More than ten years (declared by the creator)
creator.team: One person: a one-person studio, by design

foundations.en: The strategy was to build the foundations first: a server system of its own and a very optimised client, with content after that. That is why the project worked in the shadows for years.
foundations.es: La estrategia fue construir primero los cimientos: un sistema de servidores propio y un cliente muy optimizado, y el contenido después. De ahí que el proyecto trabajara años en las sombras.

useOfAI.en: COLONIZED is not a game made with AI: one person makes it, Vanguille, with AI as a tool. In the game it has been used in very specific places and very little (some sounds and some art or icons); where it is used most is in automating the information around the project: roadmap, social networks and content generation.
useOfAI.es: COLONIZED no es un juego hecho con IA: lo hace una persona, Vanguille, con la IA como herramienta. En el juego se ha usado en puntos muy concretos y muy poco (algunos sonidos y algo de arte o iconos); donde más se usa es en automatizar la información alrededor del proyecto: hoja de ruta, redes sociales y generación de contenido.

serverScale.en: The architecture is designed for around 1,000 players on a modest server. It is a design target, not a measured result: there is no public load test yet.
serverScale.es: La arquitectura está diseñada para unos 1.000 jugadores en un servidor modesto. Es un objetivo de diseño, no un resultado medido: todavía no hay una prueba de carga pública.
serverScale.level: design target, not a measured result

genre: Space survival MMORPG with realistic space simulation
platform: PC, through Steam (the store page is not public yet)
engine: Unreal Engine 5 (version 5.8 in the current build)
studioName: Giraffa (the name of the studio under which Vanguille develops COLONIZED; a brand name, not a statement about company registration)
createdBy: Vanguille, sole creator and independent developer based in Spain, with more than ten years on the project

closedAlpha.format: Steam Playtest by invitation, in small waves, on the development server
closedAlpha.participation: free of charge; 18 or older; one place per person
closedAlpha.keys: sent in waves; each friend who completes an application moves you 10 places up the list

nextPhases.closedBeta: 2027, with more testers and a dedicated server

notAnnounced: Price and business model, including whether anything will be sold in the game
Server regions and the number of players per server at launch
confirmedInTheGame: One persistent online universe on dedicated servers
Planets with atmosphere, and spherical worlds you walk on
Ships you can walk through, inside and out
Combat in first and third person
Fifteen worlds generated from their lore (four planets, ten moons and a captured asteroid), with terrain from real elevation data and physics and weather of their own; under visual review
Shots resolved on the server with lag compensation
Reputation with the five Global Guilds
A choice of side, the Zenith or the Nadir, when you enlist; it is permanent on the server

ships.note: Seven ships from three manufacturers. Specs subject to change during the alpha. Images of these ships are renders of the models, not in-game captures.

list.name: William's XASTER XL
list.role: Heavy patrol ship with a gunner

technology.rendering: Nanite, Lumen (software tracing by default) and Virtual Shadow Maps
technology.upscaling: Development build: NVIDIA DLSS package integrated (Super Resolution and DLAA, Frame Generation and Reflex on compatible GPUs; Unreal's TSR on other cards). Final options not announced
technology.servers: Dedicated Linux servers with a persistent database
technology.worlds: A G1V star, four planets with radii from 6,000 to 6,400 km, ten moons and one captured asteroid; distances compressed to fit the engine's world

novel: The Aurin Chronicle, a serialised novel set in the game's universe; Book One complete (a prologue, 13 chapters and an epilogue), free to read
